Contrast of an fNIRS activation GLM

Source: R/activation-glm.R
nirsActivationContrast.Rd

Applies a linear contrast over the condition betas of a nirsActivationGLM() fit, per channel: the estimate c' beta, its standard error sqrt(sigma^2 * c' (X'X)^-1 c), t-statistic, degrees of freedom and p-value.

Usage

nirsActivationContrast(fit, contrast)

Arguments

fit

A nirs_activation_glm.

contrast

A numeric contrast over conditions: named by condition, or an unnamed vector with one weight per condition (e.g. c(task = 1, rest = -1)).

Value

A per-channel data.frame: channel, estimate, se, t, df, p.

See also

nirsActivationGLM()
